protocol.description: Explicit FTPS over TLS; SFTP over SSH.

port.description: Defaults to 22 for SFTP, 21 for FTP/FTPS.

remotePath.description: Absolute path to an existing directory on the server.

ignore_upload.description: Root-relative paths or glob patterns excluded from every upload. Directories exclude all descendants. Added to common exclusions. Supports /pattern/flags PCRE2 regular expressions; flags: i, m, s, x, u. Escape backslashes in JSON.

ignore_download.description: Root-relative paths or glob patterns excluded from every download. Directories exclude all descendants. Added to common exclusions. Supports /pattern/flags PCRE2 regular expressions; flags: i, m, s, x, u. Escape backslashes in JSON.

debug.description: Write full protocol diagnostics, FTP commands and server replies to the Debug Console and WSFTP Sync Output. Credentials are redacted.

password.description: Server password. A credential stored in VS Code takes precedence.

passive.description: true uses EPSV/PASV; false uses active FTP with PORT/EPRT and no passive commands. Applies to FTP/FTPS listings and transfers; ignored for SFTP.

ignore_always.description: Root-relative paths or globs excluded from uploads and downloads, with no additional automatic exclusions. Supports /pattern/flags PCRE2 regular expressions; flags: i, m, s, x, u. Escape backslashes in JSON.

upload_on_save.description: Automatically upload saved documents unless excluded. Must be a boolean. uploadOnSave is not accepted.

discover.description: Discover protocol and data mode on the configured port without transferring files. On success, automatically update protocol/passive and set discover to false in the configuration, then show a confirmation.
